name: Fiora
title: the Grand Duelist

Q.name: Lunge
Q.description: Fiora lunges in a direction and stabs the closest enemy, ward, or structure, dealing 70/80/90/100/110 + BADRatio×bonus AD physical damage. The strike will prioritize Vitals and enemies it will kill. If Fiora strikes an enemy, this Ability's Cooldown is reduced by 50%.
Q.summary: Fiora lunges in a direction and stabs a nearby enemy, dealing physical damage and applying on-hit effects.

W.name: Riposte
W.description: Fiora parries all incoming damage, disables, and negative effects for 0.75 seconds, then stabs. The stab deals 110/150/190/230/270 + 1×AP magic damage to the first champion hit and Slows Move Speed by 50% and Attack Speed by 25% for 2 seconds. If Fiora parries an Immobilizing effect, the stabbed enemy is Stunned rather than Slowed.
W.summary: Fiora parries all incoming damage and disables for a short time, then stabs in a direction. This stab slows the first enemy champion hit, or stuns them if Fiora blocked an immobilizing effect with this ability.

E.name: Bladework
E.description: Fiora gains 50/60/70/80/90% Attack Speed for her next two Attacks. The first Attack Slows by 30% for 1 second. The second Attack always critically strikes for 160/170/180/190/200% damage.
E.summary: Fiora has increased attack speed for the next two attacks. The first attack slows the target, and the second attack will critically strike.

R.name: Grand Challenge
R.description: Passive: Duelist's Dance Move Speed bonus is increased to 30/40/50%. Active: Fiora reveals all four Vitals on a champion for a max of @spell.FioraPassive:RDamageTotal@ max Health true damage and gains Duelist's Dance's Move Speed bonus while near the target. If Fiora strikes all four Vitals within 8 seconds or if the target dies after she has hit at least one, Fiora restores 80/105/130 + 0.7×bonus AD Health per second to surrounding allied champions for 5 seconds.
R.summary: Fiora reveals all four Vitals on an enemy champion and gains Move Speed while near them. If Fiora hits all four Vitals or if the target dies after she has hit at least one, Fiora and her allies in the area are healed over the next few seconds.

Passive.name: Duelist's Dance
Passive.description: Fiora has revealed a Vital on this Champion. If she hits the Vital, she restores Health and gains Move Speed.
Passive.summary: Fiora has revealed a Vital on this Champion. If she hits the Vital, she restores Health and gains Move Speed.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Duelist who scores true damage on Vitals and turns the opponent's key ability against them with W (Riposte).
strengths: Q dash for trades and escapes
Vitals give true damage, healing and speed
weaknesses: Ranged poke and point-and-click crowd control are hard for her

curve.lvl1: medium – Q or E plus Vitals

profile.curveNote: Level 2 gives her the dash plus a trading tool.

Q.notes: Dash and stab; half cooldown back on hit.

W.notes: Parries all damage, disables and negative effects for 0.75 s; stuns if she parried an immobilizing effect, otherwise slows.

E.notes: Next two attacks: dodgeable by Jax E.

R.notes: Reveals 4 Vitals; heal zone if all hit or target dies.

Passive.notes: Vitals: true damage, heal, move speed.

profile.windowAgainst: W on cooldown: most melee champions can use their crowd control safely.
